description: This file is a Java interface defining the service layer for handling digital products within the sales manager application. It specifies methods for saving, updating, adding files to digital products, and retrieving digital products associated with a specific merchant store and product.

classes.name: DigitalProductService
classes.description: A Java interface that extends the generic service interface to provide methods specific to digital product management, including saving, updating, associating files, and retrieving digital products.

methods.name: saveOrUpdate
methods.description: Saves a new digital product or updates an existing one.

methods.name: addProductFile
methods.description: Associates a content file with a digital product for a specific product.

methods.name: getByProduct
methods.description: Retrieves the digital product associated with a specific merchant store and product.
